summary: First-run end-to-end testing of PAKOPPS. Backend: 24/24 pytest tests passed covering /api/config, /api/taxonomy, /api/stats, /api/home, /api/opportunities with all filters & sort, confidence_score/content_hash/source_hash fields confirmed hidden on all public responses, expired record 'Accounts Officer (BS-16)' correctly excluded by default and reachable with include_expired=true, detail+related, autocomplete, reports/contact (success + 422 validation), sitemap.xml (valid urlset), robots.txt (Sitemap line), career-guides, trust pages. Frontend: Home loads with hero, search, stats (35 Active, 33 Organizations), and all 9 sections. Search navigates to /search?q=... with results-count. Category /government-jobs lists 6 cards with sort-select & province filter visible. Expired detail page correctly shows closed banner and NO apply button. Career guides list + detail render. All 7 static pages (/about, /how-it-works, /source-policy, /editorial-policy, /privacy-policy, /terms, /disclaimer) render content. Contact + Report submissions produce success toasts. 404 route and empty-search state render correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: seed.py is large (~600 lines of static records) - acceptable since it's data, but could be moved to a JSON file for cleaner separation.
/api/opportunities regex search uses case-insensitive regex on multiple fields without a text index; fine for ~35 records but will not scale. Consider MongoDB text index when real crawling is added.
clear-filters data-testid only renders when at least one filter is active (good UX, but tests should set a filter first).
ai_service.py / Emergent LLM key loaded on startup but not invoked on any user path in this build (confirmed by task note); dead-weight import is fine but keep in mind for cleanup if not used.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 36 records on startup (35 active + 1 intentionally expired). One TEST_ prefixed contact + one TEST_ prefixed report were submitted via API during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_pakopps_api.py (pytest, 24 tests, all passing). Note that /api/trust/ only exposes 3 slugs (about, source-policy, editorial-policy); the other 'trust' routes (how-it-works, privacy-policy, terms, disclaimer) are rendered purely client-side via /app/frontend/src/lib/staticContent.js + StaticPage.jsx - do NOT assert them against the backend API. Opportunity card uses data-testid=`view-details-{slug}` (slug-suffixed), not plain 'view-details'. Expired slug for regression: accounts-officer-bs-16-provincial-department-closed. Backend returns 35 active + 1 expired = 36 total.
rca of the issue: No defects. One self-corrected test misassumption: initial test called /api/trust/{slug} for all 7 static pages, but only 3 are backend-served; corrected to assert only the 3 backend trust pages (about, source-policy, editorial-policy) + 404 for unknown slug. Frontend StaticPage.jsx renders the other 4 from client-side STATIC_PAGES map.
